title: Design System: Joseph Chombo · Production ML

display.purpose: The name in the hero only.

title.purpose: System row titles and case-study section heads.

subhead.purpose: Loop stage names, principles, career entries.

roles.purpose: The roles line under the name, in Ice.

label.purpose: Uppercase fact terms, stack groups, case meta terms.

telemetry.purpose: Hero drift status line (School drift 0.xx, Stable / Drifting / Regrouping) and the Inject drift button label.

body-compact.purpose: 16px reading under 560px, principle text, stack items.

ui-15.purpose: CTA labels, loop notes, case meta values, captions.

shadows.name: accent-koi-bloom
shadows.value: canvas shadowBlur 8px, shadowColor var(--accent-glow) = rgba(232, 100, 60, 0.45) dark / rgba(204, 74, 34, 0.25) light
shadows.purpose: The only glow in the system: the soft bloom on the vermilion koi. No box shadows exist.

ambient.name: ambient
ambient.purpose: Wash at the top of the hero.

ambient.name: nav-scrolled
ambient.value: transparent at the top; past 8px scroll: background color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 94%, transparent); border-bottom 1px solid var(--line); no backdrop-filter
ambient.purpose: The fixed nav's scrolled state. No surface in the system uses a blur.

ambient.name: grain
ambient.value: fixed fractalNoise SVG (baseFrequency .9, 160px tile), mix-blend-mode overlay, opacity 0.05 dark / 0.03 light
ambient.purpose: Film grain over the whole page; the system's only texture.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default easing for every state transition.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Borders, row hover, nav scrolled tint, and underline draw.

motion.name: cta-scan
motion.purpose: One-pass 1px scan line across a CTA on hover.

motion.name: school-fade
motion.purpose: Koi school canvas fade-in on load.

motion.name: drift
motion.value: impulse 150 to 300px/s, spring released 0.9s, then restored over 2.6s
motion.purpose: Inject drift: koi and dots scatter, then the currents regroup them. Readout goes Drifting, Regrouping, Stable.

motion.name: cursor-avoid
motion.purpose: Koi ease away from the mouse cursor.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation and transition durations 0.01ms; canvas renders one still frame; Inject drift reports Drifting, Regrouping (1.2s), Stable (2.6s) in the status line only

scrollbar.value: 10px track in var(--bg); thumb var(--line-2), 10px radius, 3px var(--bg) border

components.css: .ds-cta { position: relative; overflow: hidden; isolation: isolate; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 52px; padding: 0 20px 0 22px; font: 500 15px/1 var(--f-body, "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: var(--text, #e4f4f1); border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #1f4744); background: transparent; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cta::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--ice, #a8e6da) 14%, transparent)); transform: translateX(-101%); transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cta:hover { border-color: var(--ice, #a8e6da); } .ds-cta:hover::after { transform: translateX(0); } .ds-cta:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ice, #a8e6da); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-cta__icon { transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-cta:hover .ds-cta__icon { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-cta--primary { background: var(--cta-bg, #ddf3ee); color: var(--cta-fg, #041214); border-color: var(--cta-bg, #ddf3ee); font-weight: 600; } .ds-cta--primary::after { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--current, #7fd6c6) 30%, transparent)); } .ds-cta--primary:hover { border-color: var(--cta-bg, #ddf3ee); }

components.css: .ds-drift { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px 22px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #12302f); font-family: var(--f-body, "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-drift__status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 0; font: 400 11px/1 var(--f-mono, "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-3, #6f938d); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-drift__dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--current, #7fd6c6); } .ds-drift__value { color: var(--text, #e4f4f1); min-width: 4ch; } .ds-drift__phase { color: var(--ice, #a8e6da); } .ds-drift__inject { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line-2, #1f4744); border-radius: 0; font: 400 11px/1 var(--f-mono, "Martian Mono", ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-2, #9dbfb9); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.3s, background-color 0.3s; } .ds-drift__inject:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--ice, #a8e6da); color: var(--text, #e4f4f1); background: var(--panel, #082022); } .ds-drift__inject:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-drift__inject:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ice, #a8e6da); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 1px; } .ds-drift__note { margin: 0 0 0 auto; font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-3, #6f938d); }

narrative.overview:
A school of line-art koi drifts along hairline currents across a near-black ground with a teal undertone. The name sits large and calm beneath the school in a quiet serif. Everything else is hairline structure: rules, dashed connectors, small open nodes. The page holds still, and one living thing moves. The world is cool and almost monochrome (aqua, seafoam, ice on deep water), and a single warm vermilion appears only where the school's one odd koi swims.

Density is editorial, not dashboard. Sections run on generous vertical rhythm, lists are ruled rows instead of cards, and depth comes from tonal layering and a faint film grain, never from shadow. Motion is slow. The koi school canvas is the page's one moment, and it acts out one illustrative ML behaviour: drift. "Inject drift" scatters the school, then the currents regroup it, while a quiet status line reads the school's drift value and its state (Stable, Drifting, Regrouping). Otherwise the koi only ease away from the cursor. Reduced motion renders a still frame.

Confirmed rejections: the neon, chrome, and glitch "AI engineer" look, and the headline-over-card-grid template. The sans display alternative (Jost) was tried and rejected.
keyCharacteristics: Dark first on deep water (#041214), with a solid, fully tokened light mode.
Hairline line work (1px rules, about 1.15px koi strokes) in aqua and seafoam.
One vermilion spark, reserved for the accent koi, its light trail, a few dots, and the mark's dot.
Gilda Display for every headline, Archivo for reading and controls, Martian Mono only for the drift status line and the Inject drift button.
Square corners throughout; only dots and nodes are round.
Depth by tonal layering and film grain; no box shadows.

rules.name: The One Spark Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only on the accent koi, its trail, a handful of dots, the koi mark's dot, the Drifting state word and its dot, and the primary CTA's hover scan line. Never use it for text, headings, borders, fills, or section accents. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Cool Sea Rule
rules.body: All neutrals carry the teal undertone. Do not introduce warm greys, pure black, or pure white grounds in dark mode.

rules.name: The Theme Parity Rule
rules.body: Every color is read from a CSS custom property with dark and light values, including the canvas, which reads `--current`, `--koi`, `--accent`, and `--accent-glow` at runtime and redraws on theme change. No hard-coded colors in components. The static favicon is the one exception, and its hexes match `deep-water`, `koi-line`, and `vermilion` exactly.

rules.name: The One Serif Weight Rule
rules.body: Gilda Display is always weight 400 with -0.01em tracking. No bold, italic, or faux weights, and no sans display face.

rules.name: The Instrument Voice Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is reserved for the drift readout: the hero status line and the Inject drift button. Everything else, including the illustrative note, labels, and metadata, is Archivo.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never cast shadows. A hover state shifts tone (panel fill) or line color (ice border), never elevation.

rules.name: The Single Bloom Rule
rules.body: The soft bloom on the vermilion koi is the only glow. Text, buttons, headings, and the other koi never glow.

rules.name: The Dashed Means Pending Rule
rules.body: A dashed border or underline marks something not yet real (a pending link, an unnamed employer) or a return path. Never use dashes decoratively.

dos: **Do** read every color from the themed custom properties so dark and light stay in parity, including on canvas.
**Do** set every headline in Gilda Display at 400 with -0.01em tracking and balanced wrapping.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines and ruled rows; reach for a bordered box only for figures and decisions.
**Do** keep corners square; reserve round shapes for dots and nodes.
**Do** render missing links and names as marked pending slots (dashed, faint, `aria-disabled`), never as fake values.
**Do** keep motion slow (ease `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, 0.2 to 0.5s for states) and honor reduced motion with a still frame, reporting drift states in the status line only.
**Do** let the koi canvas fill the whole hero, behind the nav; keep the nav transparent at the top and tint it (94% ground mix, hairline border) only once scrolled.
**Do** keep the hero's bottom row to the drift status line, the one Inject drift button, and the illustrative note.
donts: **Don't** use Vermilion for text, headings, borders, fills, or section accents. It belongs to the koi, its trail, a few dots, the mark's dot, and the drifting state.
**Don't** use Martian Mono anywhere outside the drift status line and the Inject drift button.
**Don't** add koi behaviours beyond drift and easing away from the cursor.
**Don't** add box shadows, glows on text or buttons, neon, chrome, or glitch effects.
**Don't** set a sans-serif display face or bold the serif.
**Don't** lay content out as a headline over a grid of cards.
**Don't** use dashed lines decoratively; dashes mean pending or a return path.
